topic: Philippine Climate and Factors Affecting Climate
key_concepts: The Philippines has two main seasons: wet and dry.
Dry season in the Philippines occurs around December to May.
Wet season in the Philippines occurs around June to November.
Weather is day-to-day atmospheric condition while climate is long-term average weather.
Higher elevation areas are cooler than lowlands.
Mountain ranges can reduce typhoon impacts.
Distance from bodies of water moderates coastal climate.
Typhoons in the Philippines generally come from the east.
Greenhouse gases absorb and emit thermal infrared radiation.
Ocean currents move heat around the globe.
Prevailing winds and topography influence climate.
